title: Cobbles with glowing gold veins
subject: Subject: a court paved with old squarish cobbles (setts), about 3 m across, seen from straight above. Grey-brown and dusky mauve stones of mixed sizes in rough rows, dark gaps with a little moss, and thin glowing gold veins of light running through the gaps here and there in branching lines, as if light were seeping up from below; spread evenly, with no centre and no bright patch. Night colours, painted with even light (the veins glow on their own).
use: The court round the sunstone at Dawnroost's living node.

title: Old court cobbles
subject: Subject: a court paved with old squarish cobbles (setts), about 3 m across, seen from straight above. Grey and dusky mauve stones of mixed sizes laid in rough rows, rounded worn edges, dark gaps with moss and a few tiny yellow flowers. Night colours under moonlight, painted with even light.
use: The edges of the court at Dawnroost's living node.

title: Pale dais stone
subject: Subject: the face of a step of pale dressed stone, seen straight on: about 2 m of stone, 1 m high, in two courses of long squared blocks with thin mortar lines, pale warm grey with soft wear on the edges. Painted with even light.
use: The steps of the sunstone's dais at Dawnroost's living node.

title: The sunstone
subject: Subject: the sunstone, seen flat from the front: a great cluster of tall amber-gold crystals, one high pointed crystal in the middle and smaller ones round it, glowing bright gold from inside with paler facets, standing on a round stepped dais of pale stone, ringed by short black iron posts with chains slung between them. The crystal may glow, but no light spills onto the background. The whole sunstone and dais are in the picture.
use: The living sunstone node at Dawnroost, where Envoi is made.

title: Sun pattern in the floor (seen from above)
subject: Subject: a round sun pattern set into a stone floor, seen from exactly straight above, so it is a perfect circle: an outer ring of dark grey curved paving stones, inside it dark slate-grey paving with sixteen wavy gold rays inlaid from the centre outwards, and in the middle a round gold disc in a dark stone ring. The gold glows softly. The whole circle is in the picture.
use: The sun set into the court's floor in front of the sunstone.

title: Iron brazier on a stone base
subject: Subject: a tall iron brazier seen flat from the front: a round open fire basket of curved black iron bars with a fire burning in it, on a short iron stand with curled feet, standing on a square block of grey stone. The fire may glow, but no light spills onto the background. The whole brazier is in the picture.
use: The braziers round the sunstone at Dawnroost's living node.

title: Red sun banner over a brazier
subject: Subject: a banner stand seen flat from the front: a black iron pole with a cross-bar and finials, a long dark red banner with a gold border and a round gold sun with rays hanging from it, and at the pole's foot a round iron fire basket with a fire burning, on a square stone base. The whole stand is in the picture.
use: The two banner stands in the court at Dawnroost's living node.

title: Red sun banner
subject: Subject: a long hanging banner seen flat from the front: deep red cloth with a thin gold border and a pointed end, a round gold sun with straight rays in its upper half, hung from a short dark rod. The whole banner is in the picture.
use: The banners on the walls of Dawnroost's living node.

title: The node's gate
subject: Subject: a castle court's gateway seen flat from the front: a crenellated wall of grey dressed stone with a wide round arch through it, an iron lantern with warm glass on each side of the arch, and at each end a square stone pillar with a long red banner with a gold sun and an iron urn on top. The whole gate is in the picture.
use: The gate of Dawnroost's living node, down to the town.

title: Iron urn on a gatepost
subject: Subject: an iron urn seen flat from the front: a black iron vessel with a flared rim, a shield-shaped front plate with a thin raised border, a finial on top, standing on a square grey stone pillar cap. The whole urn and cap are in the picture.
use: The urns on the gateposts at Dawnroost's living node.

title: Striped-awning stall
subject: Subject: a festival stall seen flat from the front: a sagging cloth awning in broad red and white stripes on four wooden poles, red rope trim along its edge, small tables with goods and a crate, barrels, a lit lantern on a post, and two small orange pennants. The whole stall is in the picture.
use: The stall in the west corner of Dawnroost's living node.

title: Weapon rack and stall
subject: Subject: a weapon rack and a stall side by side, seen flat from the front: on the left a wooden rack with three spears standing upright and a small red banner with a gold sun; on the right a red and white striped cloth awning over barrels, a lit lantern and an orange pennant. The whole thing is in the picture.
use: The east side of the court at Dawnroost's living node.

title: Covered wagon
subject: Subject: a small covered wagon seen flat from the side: a wooden body with iron fittings, a rounded grey canvas hood with red trim, two spoked wheels, a lantern at the front. The whole wagon is in the picture.
use: The wagon in Dawnroost's living node.

title: Fire bowl on a stone post
subject: Subject: a fire bowl seen flat from the front: a round black iron bowl with a small fire burning in it, set on top of a square grey stone post. The fire may glow, but no light spills onto the background. The whole post is in the picture.
use: The fire bowls on the stair posts and wall corners at Dawnroost's living node.

title: Slim cypress
subject: Subject: a slim cypress tree seen from the side: a tall narrow flame shape of dense dark blue-green foliage, a few cold moonlit highlights, a short trunk. The base is a flat line at the bottom.
use: The cypresses by the gate of Dawnroost's living node.

title: Bush with yellow and white flowers
subject: Subject: a dense rounded bush seen from the side, dark green leaves covered in tiny white flowers with a few yellow ones. Night colours. The base is a flat line at the bottom.
use: The flower beds at Dawnroost's living node.

title: Flowering shrub in a tub
subject: Subject: a small shrub with yellow and white flowers growing in a round wooden tub bound with iron hoops, seen from the side. The whole tub and plant are in the picture.
use: The pot plants at Dawnroost's living node.
